attempts_kept.result: 3 holdout cases x 8 arms, descriptive, before the formal runs; outputs in raw-results-validation-logs.tar.gz (smoke/)

disclosures: The development set is round 50 group-C/dev tiny-template data (already reported in round 50); only the holdout is evidence.

Regression set: no candidate was rejected in any of its 196 runs (all templates cover >= 576 source pixels and no footprint left the source), so byte-identical outputs there were expected; it shows the untriggered path is unchanged, not that the checks are harmless when they trigger on large templates.

The size check lost 14 holdout strict TP per backend vs border-only (0.30% of 4704): 8 on boundary scenes (5 of them edge-crossing truths: 82 -> 77 of 185) and 6 on clean/noise scenes of the resized Dst templates.

Full GPU applies both checks to its final matches (NMS ran on the GPU), so a rejected match is not replaced; the CPU/hybrid Session checks before NMS. On this holdout the two backends differ by at most one TP and one FP.
The formal runner was built at the frozen commit bcd409d (formal-build.json); the only later change before the formal runs is the Python host-check fix in 480269d, whose snapshot is archived.

All 648 unchecked holdout false positives sit in 13 of 64 negative scenes (225 on empty procedural scenes, all at the border; 419 on procedural distractor scenes, 180 at the border); the resized Dst templates produced 4.
Times are descriptive except H6; one block, 0.3 s warm-up and 3 calls per case on one M4 Pro.
